items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a friend of mine who lived right across the street from us his name was Arthur Hoseppian... Oh yeah we are still friends right now.

ctx.x: Well we did used to steal chickens and things. (Laughs)
So you stayed in touch with Arthur even after the army and everything?
Oh yeah we are still friends right now. I could call him up this very minute
